spec.description:
Autex Quietspace Lattice - Trapezium is a geometric suspended acoustic baffle
system featuring clean angular lines that form an elongated diamond-like
trapezium lattice. Constructed from 100% polyester fibre using 12mm semi-rigid
Cube acoustic fins, it provides an expansive sound-absorbing surface area to
control ambient speech and reverberation. Supplied flat-packed with a
dedicated 4-point suspension kit, Trapezium delivers Class A acoustic
performance (NRC 1.00 / 1.60 - 3.90 Sabins per unit) and Group 1 fire safety for
open ceilings.
features:
Angular geometric trapezium form creating an
elongated architectural ceiling feature

Intersecting lattice fin design
provides maximum surface area for sound absorption

Class A acoustic
performance with NRC 1.00 (1.60 - 3.90 Sabins per unit)

Constructed from 100%
polyester fibre containing a minimum of 80% recycled PET

Group 1 fire rating
compliant with AS ISO 9705 - 2003 and AS 5637.1

Assembled dimensions: 1180 mm
x 2380 mm x 290 mm depth

Supplied flat-packed with complete suspension kit (4
x 1m cables, ceiling mounts, clips)

Lightweight, structurally stable, and
will not warp, sag, or crumble over time

Resistant to moisture, mould, and
mildew (ASTM G21-15 Growth Rating: 0)

Certified Carbon Neutral product with
third-party verified EPD

install:
Unpack Lattice Trapezium components and lay out fins on
a clean, soft work surface

Slot intersecting 12mm Cube fins together
according to the Trapezium assembly diagram

Insert alloy tube inserts and
Velda cable clips into designated locking fin slots

Measure and mark 4
suspension anchor points on the ceiling substrate matching cable positions

Fasten ceiling mounts securely to the structural ceiling or soffit using
suitable anchors

Thread 1m galvanised suspension cables into ceiling mounts
and adjust to desired hanging height

Hook cables into the Lattice clips and
level the assembled Trapezium sculpture using a spirit level
selection_checklist:
Confirm ceiling height and available overhead
clearance for 290mm deep profile

Verify ceiling structure can support 4-point
cable suspension

Select colour from the Autex Cube colour palette (20+
colours)

Confirm Trapezium style (1180mm x 2380mm rectangular angular form)
fits spatial layout

Check clearances around HVAC ducts, lighting, and fire
sprinklers
accessories:
Lattice suspension kit (4 x 1m galvanised
cables, 4 x ceiling mounts, 4 x Velda clips, alloy tube inserts)
limitations:
Indoor ceiling installation only; not suitable for
exterior use or wet environments

Non-load bearing decorative baffle; do not
suspend luminaires or mechanical services from fins

Must be assembled on a
clean, protected floor surface to avoid marking the felt

retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Quietspace Lattice - Trapezium is a geometric suspended acoustic ceiling
sculpture measuring 1180mm x 2380mm x 290mm, constructed from intersecting 12mm
Cube polyester felt fins. Engineered to cover a large acoustic surface area, it
achieves Class A sound absorption (NRC 1.00 / 1.60 - 3.90 Sabins per unit) to
capture ambient chatter and eliminate flutter echoes in open-ceiling
architecture. Rated Group 1 fire compliant under AS ISO 9705 and containing at
least 80% recycled PET, it offers an eye-catching, carbon-neutral ceiling
statement for commercial and educational spaces.
